messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Levin <sarah.levin@clearwellhealth.com>, Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@clearwellhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-12T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Post-discovery: technical immersion (60-90m) — schedule and agenda prep

Hi Sarah / Arjun,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to hear more about Clearwell's plans for embedding retrieval-augmented features into the clinician workflow. As discussed, the right next step is a 60–90 minute technical immersion with our ML infra and serving team to: align on integration surface area, validate throughput/latency expectations, and walk through a short runbook for rolling to production.

We have the following windows available next week (all PT):
- Tue 2026-12-16, 10:00–11:30 (PT)
- Wed 2026-12-17, 14:00–15:30 (PT)
- Thu 2026-12-18, 08:00–09:30 (PT)

Could you pick the preferred slot and share the internal attendees (including the primary infra/ops contact and any SRE or security reviewer)? For our side I expect Marcus (me), Monica (ops lead) and Soojin (solutions engineer) to join.

Proposed agenda (attached draft):
1) 5–10m: introductions & success criteria
2) 20–25m: architecture walk (what you’re sending, expected QPS, latency targets)
3) 20–30m: TDX lab — sample request flow, prefix caching, and quantization tradeoffs
4) 10–15m: deployment/rollout options (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
5) 10m: open questions, next steps, mutual action items

Pre-reads: SOC2 highlights + short guide on our prefix/KV caching (links attached). If you have any compliance artifacts you want us to review beforehand, please attach or link.

If your team prefers a 60m tighter agenda we can compress the lab segment — let me know.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

- Sarah Levin (me) — Director, ML Platform — sarah.levin@clearwellhealth.com
- Arjun Patel — Lead SRE — arjun.patel@clearwellhealth.com
- Priya Raman — Data Platform Eng — priya.raman@clearwellhealth.com

Two asks before we lock:
1) Can you confirm whether Redwood will provide a short SOC2 summary and any relevant data-flow diagram in advance? Our security reviewer will want the highlights.
2) We use Okta SSO and SCIM provisioning — will that be covered in the deployment options discussion or should we add an SSO engineer to the session?

Also, we prefer the session recorded (internal training) and kept for 90 days — please let us know if Redwood records and retains meeting assets.

Looking forward to the session. If that slot is now confirmed on your end, please send an invite with a calendar attachment (we work across PT/ET).

Best,
Sarah
Director, ML Platform
Clearwell Health
